summary: CR-DYN-0009 selected final_only-medium and the remote demo passed health plus one real action-4 inference step. The local SSH tunnel never passed health and the required subsequent step, then the DSW timer stopped the instance at 07:09. The exclusive poller restarted the same A10 but correctly blocked on stale demo PID 74923. localhost:7860 is not available and the experiment remains blocked.

failures.message: Three port-forward attempts timed out and a fourth cycle failed the local health-and-step check; localhost:7860 had no listener.

The DSW shutdown timer stopped the instance before local verification completed. After the exclusive poller restarted it, the persisted live-demo.pid pointed to dead PID 74923 and preflight blocked without restarting the demo.

observed: The frozen scale comparison selected final_only-medium, not large.
The remote server returned ok=true for /health and a real action-4 /api/step returned a PNG data URL as step 1.
The remote generated step took 9846.2 ms after a 27232.5 ms warmup.
No local process listened on 127.0.0.1:7860, so neither local health nor the required subsequent local step passed.
The same A10 restarted after the timer stop, but the exclusive poller reported PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED stale_demo_pid:74923.
interpretation: Checkpoint loading and one remote inference step are proven, but the user-facing local access path and sustained two-step path are not.
This is currently an infrastructure/lifecycle blocker rather than evidence that model inference itself failed.
not_established: The local-tunnel health check and subsequent real inference step.
Sustained runtime behavior across two consecutive generated steps.
User-perceived representation clarity and action responsiveness.
decision: Do not publish http://127.0.0.1:7860 as usable.
Leave restart ownership with the exclusive poller; do not bypass its stale-PID safety block from the read-only heartbeat.
Resume scientific evaluation only after remote health/step and local health/subsequent-step all pass.
